dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: All of these rare books... many of them can hardly be found at Wanwen Bookhouse, or even in all of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Ahem... If I may so ask, where do you usually collect your literature? Perhaps you could share a tip or two with a friend, my liege...?
